experiment.question: Can the reference implementation generate fresh pool and authorization proofs and pass both cryptographic verifiers in a local Ethereum transaction?
experiment.acceptance: Both fresh proofs verify, the transaction succeeds with expected state changes, and altered proof or authorization target is rejected. Transaction gas must come from an Ethereum receipt for a full benchmark result.

environment.hardware: Apple arm64, 10 logical CPUs, 34359738368 bytes RAM

fixed_trial_configuration.delivery: upstream sepolia-demo ML-KEM-768 plus X25519 encrypted envelope, one on-chain outputNoteData per output
fixed_trial_configuration.delivery_test_keys: three deterministic test key seeds from delivery/test-keys.mjs; no real user keys
fixed_trial_configuration.local_node: Anvil 1.7.1, chainId 1, Cancun, genesis timestamp 1735689000, block gas limit 30000000, code size limit disabled
fixed_trial_configuration.genesis_state: upstream assets/eip-8182/shielded-pool-state.json, 67 storage slots installed through Anvil RPC
fixed_trial_configuration.setup_note: The demo auth key is regenerated by local single-contributor trusted setup; the hashes above identify this run, and a fresh setup may produce different hashes.

measurement_plan.prover: snarkjs WASM from upstream npm lockfile
measurement_plan.auth_path: Groth16 demo fallback after Honk source mismatch; this proves knowledge of a demo secret and does not establish wallet-signature authorization
measurement_plan.statistic: median of successful receipt gas and elapsed times; preserve all attempts
measurement_plan.state_reset: anvil_reset before warmup and every formal trial, checking genesis block record
measurement_plan.timing_scope: upstream proof timing measures snarkjs.groth16.prove only, excluding witness input and witness binary generation; delivery encryptMs covers envelope preparation per output; sync records RPC fetch, decryption attempts, index processing, and wall time
measurement_plan.gas_scope: raw eth_getTransactionReceipt.gasUsed including intrinsic, calldata, execution, and refunds; deployment and registration are separate receipts; delivery bytes are part of transact calldata
measurement_plan.cache: npm and compiler outputs retained between trials; fresh proof and encrypted output generated each trial
measurement_plan.failure_policy: Record failures and do not replace them with zero or published values

post_run_audit_of_preexisting_fixed_inpu.note: These values were read after the formal run from the pinned upstream witness generator and saved per-trial pool-input.json. They were not changed between trials or used to adjust a result.
post_run_audit_of_preexisting_fixed_inpu.warm_storage_policy: Each operation is a separate Anvil transaction and receives ordinary EVM warm/cold reset; storage is not warmed by a prior call inside that transaction.
post_run_audit_of_preexisting_fixed_inpu.reset_check: The aggregate reads every trial's saved genesis JSON and checks timestamp 1735689000; the successful roots and nullifier checks also distinguish a fresh state from residue.
